sources.title: AI-image-detector: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview AI-image-detector is a Vision Transformer (ViT) model built by umm-maybe to classify whether artistic images were generated by AI or created by humans. The model performs binary classification using the transformers library and was trained using AutoTrain (Model ID: 1519658722) in October 2022.
